A federation of JAX/XLA libraries for neuroimaging — from GPU numerics up to
dataset-aware workflows — documented as one hub with a shared black theme and a
single bold accent per library that tells you where you are.

::: {.callout-tldr title="Fast path"}
New here and want the shortest route to understanding? Each library's
**Explanation** section opens with a fast-path block. Start with
{{< xref nitrix:fellner-schall "nitrix · Fellner–Schall" >}} for the textbook
layer, or {{< xref tensorbids:architecture "tensorbids · architecture" >}} for
the on-disk data model.
:::

## Libraries

The accent colour beside each library is how you know which part of the
federation you are reading. This legend is generated from `libraries.yml`, so it
cannot drift from the build.

{{< include federation/_legend.md >}}

## How the federation is layered

- **Substrate numerics** — `nitrix` (pure JAX/XLA numerics), `niffi` (FFI to
  community C/C++ kernels), `ilex` (local ML inference + training).
- **Glue** — `thrux` (in-memory dispatch + graph assembly), `bitsjax`
  (dataset-level awareness over the on-disk structure).
- **On-disk reference** — `tensorbids` (the BITS data structure).
- **High-level** — `hyve` (visualisation), `entense` (ETL/workflows).
- **DSL & composition utilities** — `gramform`, `conveyant`.

This Phase-1 hub builds two of them end to end (`nitrix`, `tensorbids`) to prove
the federation plumbing: shared theme, cross-library references
({{< xref tensorbids:architecture "see tensorbids" >}}), a validating build, and
unified search.
